_comment: #016 framewise loss: weighted MSE on the predicted activation map vs Gaussian-smoothed target. Per-sample positive-class weighting (clamped [10, 200]) compensates for the ~1.5% positive-bin rate. Min-SNR γ=5 weighting on (from #015's lessons). No STOP class. Canonical operating point τ=0.5 with tolerance ±2 frames; the 101-threshold sweep + 5-tolerance grid live in the rollout/curve metric modules.
